Sharp braking can cause the car's wheels to lock and drift. To avoid an accident, it is necessary to reduce speed in such places. Be especially careful when braking in places where plastic markings are applied, as well as on sections of the road at the initial moment of raindrops. When the roadway is wetted, in some cases a thin layer (dust + moisture) is formed, which further impairs the grip of the wheels on the road.
